description: The Folders window lists the data folders under the Epicenter folder root and opens each with the page's own engine. Listing permits the window into each folder's scope; the folder plugin then grants it the directory and reads and changes it. Through the narrow CLI runner (ADR-0556) it runs `epicenter check` on a folder it was granted (folder_check), runs that folder's history as one `epicenter` child per operation (status, history, save_version, sync, settle_sync, ADR-0559), starts what installs `git` when the CLI finds none (install_git), and through it sends AI requests and manages a connection's key in the keychain without reading it (ADR-0557). It also lists the apps in a repository, and installs, approves, updates, and opens installed apps (ADR-0540, ADR-0552), and opens Settings (ADR-0537). The window listens for the folder plugin's change event, epicenter-folder://changed, and for the shell's epicenter://data-folders-changed, sent when the list of data folders may have changed.
